meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器,完成点击、填表、截图与页面检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要让程序替你在真实网站上点击、填表或采集数据。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser to click, fill forms, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a program to click, fill forms, or scrape real websites.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 omowright 库驱动一个真实浏览器:在用户已登录的站点里导航、点击、填表、读页面和截图,遇到登录、验证码或 OTP 时暂停并请你手动接管。默认走 attached 引擎,即你自己的浏览器和已有登录状态。
howto.when: 当你要做需要交互的浏览器任务时触发,例如在已登录的站点里导航、填表或截图等;纯搜索、无拦截的静态抓取不走它。

say.text: 打开我浏览器里已登录的那个网站,帮我截个图
say.note: 用你自己的会话,不动登录状态

say.text: 在这个页面上填好表单,然后点提交按钮
say.note: 先读页面快照拿到引用再操作

say.text: 验证码我自己手动过,过完你接着往下走
say.note: 会暂停请求你接管,之后再读页面继续

howto.what_en: Claude drives a real browser through the omowright library: navigate, click, fill forms, read pages and take screenshots on sites you're already signed into, and pause for you to handle login, CAPTCHA or OTP. It defaults to the attached engine — your own browser and its logins.
howto.when_en: Triggers for any interactive browser task, e.g. navigating a site you're signed into, filling a form or taking a screenshot. Not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

say_en.text: Open the site I'm already signed into in my browser and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Uses your own session, leaves logins alone

say_en.text: Fill in the form on this page, then click submit
say_en.note: Reads a snapshot for refs before acting

say_en.text: I'll do the CAPTCHA by hand, then you continue
say_en.note: Pauses for you to take over, then re-reads the page
